title: snippet.rs: 'Filter::Operator(_) | _' has unreachable arm (clippy::unreachable_patterns)
description: snippet.rs:54: 'jmap_mail_types::query::Filter::Operator(_) | _ => None' — the wildcard arm _ already matches Filter::Operator(_), making the explicit variant arm unreachable. Clippy will flag this as unreachable_patterns. Fix: 'jmap_mail_types::query::Filter::Condition(c) => Some(c), _ => None'
